flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 95% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -2% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love

flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: Borrowings above equity leave limited room if the cycle turns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
West Asia presents a risk not of geography, but of transmission through higher oil prices, shipping costs, and customer confidence.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The first is West Asia, where the risk is not geography but transmission through higher oil prices, the cost of shipping, and, over time, the confidence of the customer." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Industry-level bureau data reveals building stress concentrated in small-ticket loans and multiple-lender borrowers.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The bureau data for the industry now shows a clear divergence beneath a calm surface." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: As a measure of prudence, disbursements were reduced by approximately 7% and lending was paused across roughly 450 pin codes flagged for elevated risks.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "As a measure of prudence, we reduced disbursements by approximately 7% and paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes, where early-warning systems flagged elevated risks - while continuing to grow in high-quality segments." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)
